content: Step two takes the cyclopentyl cap down to a cyclopropyl - 28 Da and about a log unit, and activity-neutral every time I have measured it. Together these should bring the molecule to roughly 331 Da at LogP near 2.9 while leaving the flat aromatic at C4 that earned the 0.70. Across this generation I am testing pyridine, pyrimidine, pyridazine, methylpyrazole and methylimidazole in that position: if activity is about presenting a flat ring there, they should all hold and I pick on drug-likeness; if it is about the ring's electron density, they will separate and tell me which direction to push.
